utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — let’s lock that down. I can bring the tools and set a clear drop-off window so it’s easy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot. What time window are you thinking, and where should people leave the items?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can work around the school schedule, but I’ll need the repair drive timing first. What day are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I’m still sorting the timing, but I should know the day soon and I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Uli — just send it over when you know, and I’ll fit it around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly just a heads-up on what needs fixing and when folks are free to help. I’m still getting the details second-hand, so anything you can share would help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can get you a quick list of the main fixes and some times people might be around. I’ll send what I know soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what should I bring to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: If you can, bring a screwdriver set, some spare batteries, and any small tools you’ve got. Snacks or a folding table would also be super helpful!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring a screwdriver set and some spare batteries. I’ll also see if I can grab a folding table.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—just let me know where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Awesome, Rey — could you swing by a little later and help sort the tools? That’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can do that. Just tell me what time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help—what’s the repair drive asking for, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re collecting repair supplies like tape, screws, glue, batteries, and a few basic tools. It’s happening this Saturday afternoon at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — repair supplies and basic tools for this Saturday afternoon at the community shed. I can help gather a few things, but I want to check what’s still needed first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to ask about that. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Just bring whatever tools you can spare — screwdrivers, a hammer, maybe some duct tape. If you’ve got a folding chair or an extra extension cord, that’d be great too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do that — I think I’ve got a screwdriver, maybe the hammer too, and I’ll look for the duct tape and extension cord. I’ll bring a folding chair if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara—could you help me make a quick list of the homes that need repairs and note any urgent fixes?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll put together a quick list of the homes and flag any urgent fixes I spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help track the repair drive spots—what location should I note first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Start with the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community center parking lot noted first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep checking around too and pass along anything I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll do the same and let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, but I’m happy to help out if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not totally sure what’s left yet—I may have missed that update. If you tell me the remaining tasks, I can help right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the next step, if you’ve got one. I can help best if we keep it simple and stick to a routine.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — let’s keep it simple: pick the next repair item, gather the needed tools, and set a time to work on it. I’ll help keep the routine steady and easy to follow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help with that—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m thinking we should keep it simple: pick a time, make a list of what needs fixing, and see who can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible to me. Let’s pick a time, and I’ll bring a notepad for the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm you’ll actually let me know if you hear anything?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — if I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll send the repair drive details over—just let me know if you can bring any tools or extra supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can probably bring a basic toolkit and some gloves. Send me the list, and I’ll check what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive organized, Leo—let’s make sure we cover the homes that need it most. Can you help me check who’s still waiting?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I can help with that. Send me the list, and I’ll check who’s still waiting.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo—thank you. I’ll send the list over now, and we can start with the oldest requests.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort donated tools and sign people in on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I can sort the donated tools and help sign people in Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’m already telling folks about the repair drive. Come by later and I’ll make sure you’ve got all the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll stop by later and hear the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll be around, and I’ll fill you in when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—where’s it happening, and what do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally up to speed either, but I heard it’s at the community hall. They still need volunteers and a few tools, I think.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — community hall is good to know. I’ll ask around for volunteers and see if anyone can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m in. Just remind me what we’re fixing, and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re just gathering the usual neighborhood fixes—whatever’s broken, loose, or needs a hand. I’ll remind everyone of the details and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. Just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll pitch in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help connect folks and spread the word about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and maybe connect me with anyone who’s good at fixing small appliances?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and think of anyone handy with small appliances. If someone comes to mind, I’ll connect you right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — appreciate it. I’ve got a toolbox ready if anyone needs it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Gus — I’m sure folks will be glad to have you on hand. I’ll swing by if I hear anyone needs a helping hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact details of the repair drive first? I want to make sure I get everything right before I act.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what exact details do you need about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, location, and what items you want people to bring? I’ll make sure I have the full picture before I help.
